author: xCurry
body: Ok so I got banned for Ban evading on this server. I didnt know that ban evading was a thing actually. I always thought that It was some kind of hack for evading attacks or something like that. I didnt know that using an alt was a while main was being banned was a ban evade. I am sorry and I will never do it again. Please let me join in. You can keep the 2 week ban but I dont want the perm ban. I love playing avicus. It was my first server that I had ever played on. So please let me in.

title: Appeal for BlurryBear

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Ban evasion is not permitted and will result in a permanent ban on all accounts associated with the original Minecraft account.

Hello, ban evasion is not allowed on Avicus, which is stated in the rules. Players are responsible to keep up with the rules and if you are caught rule breaking, it is your fault not ours. Please try appealing in 6-8 months to appeal again and your chances of getting unbanned are higher.

replies.body:
Hello BlurryBear,

The rules clearly states that ban evasion is not permitted on The Avicus Network. It is your fault for not reading through the rules, and you'll have to face the concequences. As Junr mentioned, appeal in 6-8 months if you'd like to come back. This appeal is denied. Have a great day.

Regards,
Jiveh
